source_policy: Auxiliary train.csv only; exclude all target heldout/valid/test canonical molecules and scaffolds. At most three fixed related tasks, original REL order then sorted extension; no label-dependent source selection.
selection: Complete fixed graph family, select alpha once on reused scaffold OOF; then official valid and repeat gates. No runner-up retry after failure. Preserve frozen v9 for rejected tasks.
notes: Task-conditioned atom attention and feature gates fuse directed bond messages, descriptors, frozen ChemBERTa embeddings and Morgan fingerprints.
Shared graph encoder with task-specific heads; target weight 0.7, total auxiliary weight 0.3; fresh target permutation per epoch.
Spearman uses fit-only log standardization for nonnegative targets instead of Gaussian rank inverse; MAE uses robust median/IQR.
Existing primary/secondary gates retained and low-similarity auxiliary metric gate added. No subgroup safety claim where coverage is insufficient.
All validation sets have historical reuse and selection bias. Cannot project platform score or guarantee hidden-set non-regression.
No external labels or test-label access. No automatic platform submission.
